title: Chat Ticket Promotion Contract
approach: Add requested_mode field to ChatRequest. Mode switch determines: interactive (200), ticketed (201), auto (202). Backward compatible defaults.
constraints_respected: Backward compatible: absent requested_mode defaults to auto
Real-time revalidation via guardian.ValidateModeSurface before ticket creation

key_design_decisions.rationale: Align mode/overlay enforcement with real network side-effects
key_design_decisions.impact: interactive chat is denied in READ_ONLY and under SAFE_MODE

key_design_decisions.decision: Auto tries interactive, then falls back to ticket
key_design_decisions.rationale: Keep interactive UX when allowed; provide deterministic ticket promotion when not
key_design_decisions.impact: IT_OP denies network, so auto promotes to ticket (202) when guardian is active

key_design_decisions.rationale: Keep deterministic error ordering for invalid provider
key_design_decisions.impact: E_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND returned before mode switching logic

out_of_scope: Persistencia mes enlla del ticket creat
mvp_limitation: Interactive 200 path is not tested end-to-end (we avoid real LLM calls); requires mock provider config/harness.
